objective: Expose the raw DR24 endpoint in the Workbench so a user can inspect one indexed OID, its native HMJD light curve, raw epoch fields, and acquisition provenance without invoking the frozen model or applying unvalidated normalization.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #264 adds a bounded raw-only DR24 HATS adapter and explicit API endpoint.
The current Workbench uses the ALeRCE normalized observation route and labels its time axis MJD.
DR24 HMJD is heliocentric and must not be relabeled as geocentric MJD.
DR24 OIDs are partitioned by filter/field/quadrant; do not infer physical-source identity from OID alone.
Raw DR24 photometry and catflags must remain unmodified until a separate contract is approved.

baseline.description: Stacked Workbench-only UI extension on the raw DR24 adapter branch. No changes to model, feature schema, class order, benchmark, scientific thresholds, or source data.

correctness.before: Workbench has no user-facing path to call the raw DR24 endpoint; its existing light-curve view is the normalized ALeRCE observation path with MJD labeling.
correctness.after: Added a distinct DR24 Explorer view that calls the explicit raw endpoint, labels the horizontal axis HMJD, and displays source-native fields and provenance. It performs no inference or normalization.

reliability.reason: No live DR24 acquisition or browser end-to-end test has been run for this UI branch.

reproducibility.before: Raw API responses were not inspectable through the Workbench.
reproducibility.after: The UI displays the API-returned query, schema hash, payload hash, and retrieval provenance. A live source-backed replay is still required.

scientific_validity.reason: The view is a raw data inspector. It does not measure classification, calibration, astrophysical identity, or anomaly performance.

regression_protection_count.reason: No JavaScript test harness is configured in the inspected Workbench files; browser interaction testing remains required.

measurement.trade_off: Provide a minimal, transparent raw-source inspector first. Do not add unsupported source normalization, OID merging, or classifier controls.

evidence: Inspected the raw DR24 API route and response contract on PR #264 head.
Inspected the current Workbench navigation, main-canvas view routing, and existing observation display.
Added a separate DR24 navigation entry and single-OID raw viewer.
The chart uses the returned hmjd and explicitly labels it HMJD (HJD - 2400000.5).
The epoch table preserves hmjd, mag, magerr, clrcoeff, and catflags and limits visible rows to 50.
Bit-15 epochs receive a distinct plot marker only; no records are filtered or excluded.
Provenance display includes the API-returned source manifest and payload hash.
Live source-backed UI execution and browser tests have not been performed. PR is stacked on #264 and requires #264 first.

root_causes: The current Workbench has no DR24 navigation route or UI component.
The existing chart labels its time axis MJD and is tied to the normalized observation flow.
unresolved: No multi-object sample workflow, curated OID grouping, or 5–10 object run exists yet.
No versioned DR24 quality/exclusion policy or normalized feature contract is implemented.
No browser automation or live source-backed test has been run on this branch.

findings: Raw DR24 inspection should be a separate Workbench view from normalized baseline inference.
HMJD must be shown explicitly in both plot and UI labels.
Raw catflags can be visualized but must not be silently applied as a filter.
Payload hashes and query provenance should be visible to support reproducible review.
An empty OID response must remain an explicit no-row state; do not substitute ALeRCE.

open_blockers: Run current-head CI, CodeQL, and product-scope checks.
Perform browser interaction tests for valid, invalid, missing, and source-failure OIDs.
Perform a bounded live DR24 retrieval and verify the UI display against the raw API payload.
Add the curated multi-object demo workflow only after the single-OID viewer is verified.

knowledge_carried_forward: Merge or otherwise integrate PR #264 before this stacked UI change.
Keep raw DR24 data separate from frozen v0.2.0 inference.
Do not merge OIDs, apply color correction, or relabel HMJD.
Complete live source-backed smoke testing before claiming Park MVP readiness.
